bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8. LUKE SKYWALKER must not be harshly judged for an unplaced lone Quirindi effort to date as there were excuses on that occasion. He kept trying in defeat from in front at Gunnedah last start and similar tactics can be adopted today. TARRANT COUNTY was produced fourth up when he stepped up to tackle this distance here last start and his effort was very solid. He's race-fitter for 1450m with that effort now behind him. SHARE OUR SECRET will have scope to improve when he presents third up today. He wasn't disgraced at Gunnedah and a tongue tie has now been added to his gear. TURPIN'S TORMENT and ALBERT'S PICK are others who can can be considered as worthy possibilities.

raceTips.comment: Albert's Pick was seemingly doing her best work at the back end of the race last time so the rise in distance suits. She should get a soft run and has already been supported in betting prior to race day. Stormy Malice strips fitter third up and should appreciate the rise in distance. Like most of them, form can be mixed and she has had her fair share of chances. Luke Skywalker led throughout over this trip last time and was gallant in defeat. A repat effort puts him in good stead here. Tarrant County next.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 4, 6, 7, 10. HIGHLAND DANCER begins her second campaign today and she has the form behind her to be regarded as hard to beat first up this afternoon. Be however guided by market moves after she parades as she hasn't been given a lead-up trial. MAGATAMA begins her second campaign after winning her lead-up trial at Gosford. She should not be harshly judged for either unplaced effort before her spell. There were excuses on both occasions. HANEY can only present race-fitter for a solid front-running first up effort at his Tamworth home base.  BASTIANINI will concede race-day experience to all when he makes his debut today. After trialing recently at Gunnedah, he shouldn't be underestimated today with blinkers already a part of his gear. FIOGGIA had too much to do on debut at home (Tamworth). HIs unplaced effort must be forgiven when he now competes in winkers for the first time.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 5, 7, 10. SANBINA had been kept fresh before she did all but win when she stepped up to tackle this trip for the first time last start at Tamworth. She presents fresh again when she will be making her Quirindi debut today and when she will have scope to improve. MEMPHIS BLUE should appreciate a switch back to this journey when he presents after a freshen-up today. He did overcome problems to score over 1600m at Tamworth two starts ago before there were excuses at Scone last start over a much longer trip. JUPITER HILLS caused her own problems at Coonabarabran last start when she was slow to leave the gates. Improved barrier manners would aid her cause over the same distance today when she will be competing in blinkers for the first time. KYYSTINA KERIMA endured too tough a run at Grafton and her unplaced effort must be ignored when she drops in class, making her Quirindi debut today.

raceTips.comment: Sanbina was only grabbed right over the line over this distance last start and has more upside than most in this field. The gap between runs suits, just needs to slot in from a wide gate early. Immortal Rose comes off a last start win here and maps to receive every chance to go back to back. Jupiter Hills hasn't won for a long time but was good last start and a repeat performance puts her in good stead to go one better. Krystina Kerima has scope to improve and looks over the odds.

ENNIROC finished unplaced at Grafton however his effort was better than it appears at face value and he's now more than ready to make a Quirindi debut. bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 4, 8, 10. STAR WHISPERER was dominant when he was resuming over this distance two starts ago at Muswellbrook. His subsequent Rosehill performance can be overlooked and his best form can be regained this afternoon. SINGING STAR endured too tough a run in transit when she tackled this trip last start at Dubbo. Her previous Scone effort over the same journey was more than solid and with a tongue tie now added to her gear, she should be treated with respect today. She begins another preparation today and market moves after she parades may offer the best guide to her prospects as unlike last campaign, she hasn't been given a lead-up trial? NORTHERN BOOGIE and KAWATIRI are others who can be considered.
